markscheme.html:
A

The minimum energy for electron emission is the work function, Φ. It is calculated using the formula Φ = hf₀, where h is Planck's constant and f₀ is the threshold frequency. Given f₀ = 1000 THz = 1 × 10¹⁵ Hz, the energy is (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s) × (1 × 10¹⁵ Hz) = 6.63 × 10⁻¹⁹ J.
